description.EN: South Bali keeps building, but piped water can’t always keep up. In Pecatu and nearby areas, tanker prices run IDR 300,000–700,000 per tanker load — a direct cost to villas, resorts, and commercial properties. DRYNO helps owners plan ahead with site-specific surveys, deep wells, and permits.
description.ID: Bali selatan terus membangun, tetapi pasokan air PDAM tak selalu mencukupi. Di Pecatu dan sekitarnya, harga air tangki mencapai Rp300.000–Rp700.000 per ritase — biaya nyata bagi vila, resor, dan properti komersial. DRYNO membantu pemilik merencanakan sejak awal lewat survei spesifik lokasi, sumur dalam, dan perizinan.

fullDesc.EN: We drill to the depth your site actually needs — based on geoelectric survey data, rock formation, and target yield. Crawler rigs reach 220 m+ through Uluwatu karst limestone. Method, diameter (4-8 inch), and casing are matched to each project geology and water demand. Typical villa projects complete in 7-14 days including testing.

Metode, diameter (4-8 inci), dan casing disesuaikan dengan geologi dan kebutuhan debit tiap proyek. Proyek vila umumnya selesai 7-14 hari termasuk pengujian.

question.EN: Why is a ground water investigation recommended before drilling?
question.ID: Mengapa investigasi air tanah (geolistrik) sangat disarankan sebelum pemboran?

answer.EN: Yes — a geoelectric survey maps aquifers before you drill, cutting dry-hole risk. Ground Water investigation (geoelectric survey) provides critical subsurface information to identify potential ground water-bearing zones, estimate depth indications, and assess geological formations before drilling. This minimizes financial risk and helps select the most optimal drilling point.
answer.ID: Ya — survei geolistrik memetakan akuifer sebelum dibor, menekan risiko bor kering. Survei geolistrik menyajikan data formasi bawah permukaan yang akurat untuk mendeteksi lapisan pembawa air (akuifer), memperkirakan kisaran kedalaman, serta memetakan batuan keras. Hal ini sangat meminimalkan risiko biaya bor kering (dry hole) dan membantu memilih titik bor terbaik.

question.EN: How deep do you usually drill for deep wells in Bali & NTB?
question.ID: Berapa rata-rata kedalaman pemboran sumur dalam di Bali & NTB?

answer.EN: 100–220m+ in Uluwatu karst, shallower in plains. Depth is set by survey, never guaranteed. Drilling depths vary significantly based on location and regional hydrogeology. For instance, cliff terrain in Uluwatu or Pecatu may require depths between 100m to 220m+, whereas coastal plains or inland areas may require different depths. We do not guarantee a universal depth and determine drilling depth according to site conditions.
answer.ID: 100–220m+ di karst Uluwatu, lebih dangkal di dataran. Kedalaman ikut survei, tak pernah dijamin. Kedalaman sangat bervariasi tergantung topografi dan hidrogeologi kawasan. Sebagai contoh, di area tebing Pecatu dan Uluwatu kedalaman sering berkisar 100m hingga 220m+, sedangkan di dataran pesisir atau lembah bisa lebih dangkal. Kami tidak menerapkan kedalaman universal, melainkan disesuaikan dengan kondisi lapangan.

question.EN: How long does a typical deep well drilling project take?
question.ID: Berapa lama estimasi pengerjaan proyek sumur dalam?

answer.EN: Typically 2–4 weeks for drilling plus casing, depending on depth, rock, and access. On average, field drilling and well casing installation take between 2 to 4 weeks, depending on target depth, subsurface rock hardness, site accessibility, and weather conditions.
answer.ID: Umumnya 2–4 minggu untuk pengeboran plus casing, tergantung kedalaman, batuan, dan akses. Rata-rata pelaksanaan pengeboran dan pemasangan casing memakan waktu antara 2 hingga 4 minggu, tergantung kedalaman target, kekerasan formasi batuan, kemudahan akses alat berat, serta cuaca.

question.EN: What is SIPA and why is it necessary for my commercial project?
question.ID: Apa itu SIPA dan mengapa wajib dimiliki oleh properti komersial?

answer.EN: SIPA is the official permit for commercial groundwater use — operating without one risks sanctions. SIPA (Surat Izin Pengusahaan Air Tanah) is the official government permit required for ground water extraction and utilization. Having a valid SIPA ensures your villa, resort, or commercial project remains legally compliant with environmental regulations.
answer.ID: SIPA adalah izin resmi pemanfaatan air tanah komersial — tanpa SIPA berisiko sanksi. SIPA (Surat Izin Pengusahaan Air Tanah) adalah izin legal resmi dari pemerintah untuk pengambilan dan pemanfaatan air tanah. Memiliki SIPA yang sah menjamin vila, hotel, resor, atau bisnis komersial Anda beroperasi secara legal dan bebas dari sanksi lingkungan.

question.EN: Which areas in Indonesia does DRYNO cover?
question.ID: Wilayah mana saja yang dicakup oleh layanan DRYNO?

answer.EN: All of Bali, Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida, and Lombok/Sumbawa (NTB). DRYNO provides integrated ground water solutions across Bali, Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida, and West Nusa Tenggara (NTB) including Lombok and surrounding regions.
answer.ID: Seluruh Bali, Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida, serta Lombok/Sumbawa (NTB). DRYNO melayani seluruh wilayah Bali (Badung, Gianyar, Tabanan, Buleleng, Karangasem, dll.), Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida, serta Nusa Tenggara Barat (Lombok dan Sumbawa).

We will review your project location, estimated water requirements, and site accessibility to provide a detailed project proposal.
